name: vibestretch
description: Stretch, move and rest your eyes while your coding agent works — friendly nudges on long-running turns.

interface.longDescription: While a long agent turn keeps you waiting, vibestretch shows one line with a stretch, a micro-workout or an eye break, and plays a quiet chime. It counts only the minutes a turn kept you at the machine, nudges at most once every 15 minutes, and stays silent through quick turns. It is three hooks and a POSIX shell script: no dependencies, no network access, no telemetry, and nothing is added to the model's context. In Codex there is no desktop banner and no status line segment, only the line and the chime.
